verdict.rationale: Godot supports headless execution (`--headless`), full CLI tooling, and EditorScript/_run() scripts that can be scripted to build, export, or process assets without a person driving the GUI — enabling background automation such as CI pipelines and dedicated-server runs. However there is no native scheduler, task runner, or AI-agent orchestration layer for autonomous, ongoing background automations; the automation is limited to invokable CLI/editor scripts rather than a persistent agentic system. Missing for 10: built-in autonomous task scheduling/orchestration, first-party AI-agent automation framework, evidence of long-running unattended agent workflows beyond one-shot CLI/export/build scripts.
